option.name: originalContent
option.value:
@ECHO OFF SETLOCAL
SET WRAPPER_JAR="%~dp0.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.jar" SET WRAPPER_PROPERTIES="%~dp0.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.properties"
IF NOT EXIST %WRAPPER_JAR% ( FOR /F "tokens=1,2 delims==" %%A IN (%WRAPPER_PROPERTIES%) DO ( IF "%%A"=="wrapperUrl" SET WRAPPER_URL=%%B ) IF "%WRAPPER_URL%"=="" SET WRAPPER_URL=https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/wrapper/maven-wrapper/3.3.2/maven-wrapper-3.3.2.jar ECHO Downloading Maven wrapper... powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri '%WRAPPER_URL%' -OutFile '%~dp0.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.jar'" )
SET MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%~dp0 SET MAVEN_OPTS=%MAVEN_OPTS%
java -classpath %WRAPPER_JAR% -Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR% org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain %* IF %ERRORLEVEL% NEQ 0 EXIT /B %ERRORLEVEL%
ENDLOCAL
